message.content: Contoso DevBot
How do I completely wipe my local checkout of invoice-service?
Quickest way is to delete the whole directory: `rm -rf ~/work/invoice-service`. That removes the checkout and all local changes in one shot.
Contoso DevBot

Run `git log --oneline -n 20` to see the most recent commits.
